v.s: Uranus releases two energy blades that orbit around him, dealing 155( +30% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemy targets and slowing them by 30% for 2s. \nEach time this skill deals damage to a target, they will be marked with a stack for 6s (max of 1 stack per target per cast). Each stack increases the damage of this skill by 40% (to a max of 320%). Each energy blade will only deal damage to the same target once.
Remember that Radiance can increase the damage of this skill. To make Uranus’s daggers even more lethal, try to wait until has many stacks of Radiance before using this skill.

Uranus charges to the target location, dealing 80( +20% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies along the way, and 160( +80% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies at the target location and slowing them by 25%. Uranus also generates a 300( +200% Total Magic Power) shield for 4s.\nThe shield explodes at the end of its duration or when destroyed, dealing 300( +150% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies nearby.
When Uranus is attacked while Transcendent Ward is active, he enjoys the same healing effects of Radiance. Use Transcendent Ward while Uranus is jungling to make him practically invulnerable.

Uranus unleashes the energy stored within his body, removing slow effects on himself, recovering 200 HP, and gaining 60% Movement Speed for 8s (decays over time).\nUranus directly gains 5 stacks of Radiance, increasing shields received and HP Regen by 20% for 8s.
The benefit of Consecration is that it allows you to gain stacks for Radiance. Don’t be afraid to use Consecration liberally when Uranus is running out of stacks!

Uranus absorbs the energy generated by incoming attacks to strengthen himself, regenerating a certain amount of HP every 0.8s. Each stack lasts 10s. When at max stacks (20), Uranus regenerates 48-224 HP (scales with level).
Try to maintain Uranus’s Radiance at a high number of stacks to greatly improve his ability to recover. One of the easiest methods is to purposely lure an enemy turret’s attack with Uranus.
Unique Passive - Mana Spring: Regenerates 15% Max Mana every 10s.
Unique Passive - Valor: Gain 4 extra Physical Defense for 3s when taking Physical Damage, up to 20.
Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.
Unique Passive - Arctic Cold: Reduces the Attack Speed of nearby enemy heroes to 70% of normal.
Unique Passive - Deter: When hit by a skill, reduces the attacker's Physical Damage by 4% for 2s (this effect stacks up to 3 times).

Unique Passive - Brute Force: Each second after dealing damage, gain 6 extra Physical Attack and Magic Power and 2% extra Movement Speed for 4s, up to 6 stacks. Gain 15% extra Control Duration Reduction at full stacks.
